name: Eroge Shiyou yo!
source:
The three beautiful childhood friends were eroge addicts!

Yuyuka Minose, the queen-like charming childhood friend is a moe romance eroge fanatic!
Mawaru Minose, the seemingly pure and innocent twin sister, is actually a hardcore eroge fanatic!
Meguri Minose, the quiet, mysterious, and slightly quirky twin, is a yandere eroge fanatic who’s in fact obsessed with the protagonist!

The protagonist accidentally discovers their dark secrets.
He tries to pretend he didn’t see anything, but things don’t go as planned.

Yuyuka, desperate to keep her embarrassing secret under wraps, tries to silence him.
Mawaru decides to make out of the protagonist her ideal man.
Meguri, who adores the protagonist, wants to be his "pet dog."
They all show up at his house, ready to seduce him!

To make matters worse, they’re convinced that these eroge-like developments are "totally normal"…

Can the protagonist survive the invasion of these eroge girls into his real life?
A life that feels like an eroge, living with three beautiful, eroge-obsessed childhood friends.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006655.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
3名美丽的青梅竹马，竟然全是色情游戏成瘾者！

女王般迷人的青梅竹马三乃濑由由花，是萌系恋爱色情游戏的狂热爱好者！
看似纯洁天真的双胞胎姐妹三乃濑回，其实是个硬核色情游戏迷！
安静、神秘又有些古怪的另一名双胞胎三乃濑巡，则是病娇色情游戏迷，实际上对主人公无比痴迷！

主人公意外发现了她们不为人知的黑暗秘密。
他本想装作什么都没看到，事情却没有照计划发展。

由由花急于掩盖令人羞耻的秘密，决定让他永远闭嘴。
回则准备将主人公改造成自己理想中的男人。
深爱主人公的巡，更希望成为他的“宠物狗”。
她们齐聚主人公家中，准备使尽浑身解数诱惑他！

更糟糕的是，她们坚信这些色情游戏般的展开“完全正常”……

面对色情游戏少女们对现实生活的入侵，主人公能够幸存下来吗？
与3名美丽的色情游戏成瘾青梅竹马一同生活，每天都像置身色情游戏之中。
